gradeBands.name: Primary
gradeBands.description: Our primary school program (Classes I–V) focuses on building strong foundational skills in literacy, numeracy, and social-emotional development. Through interactive, play-based, and activity-driven methods, we cultivate a lifelong love of learning and nurture the natural curiosity of children.

gradeBands.name: Middle School
gradeBands.description: The middle school program (Classes VI–VIII) broadens students' academic horizons by introducing structured sciences, advanced mathematics, and computer education. We encourage critical thinking, analytical reasoning, and hands-on laboratory experiences to foster deeper scientific inquiry.

gradeBands.name: Secondary
gradeBands.description: Our secondary school program (Classes IX–X) is dedicated to rigorous academic preparation for the board examinations while developing life skills and career awareness. We place special emphasis on conceptual clarity, regular assessments, and counseling to ensure competitive readiness and holistic growth.
